title: Decision page: how a drag-and-drop reorder becomes a reviewed PR
goal: The owner has the options for the write path and a recommendation
acceptance: docs/decisions/solution-order-reorder.md sets out the options: (a) the live index service gains one narrow write tool that opens a PR changing only docs/solution-order.md (token scoped to this repository, contents and pull requests only); (b) NERV's card hands the new order to a NERV job that opens the PR; (c) the card only produces the reorder instruction text for the owner to paste into a session. Each with what it breaks in F-024's read-only rule, its token and its failure modes, and a recommendation

The page states the invariants every option keeps: no silent write to main, references validated, a stale base rejected, only the lines between the order markers change, the PR is reviewed and merged by the owner
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One decision page next to the live index one. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
